creators.name: Werner van der Zwan
creators.bio: Dutch artist and filmmaker who fits found objects and scrapyard furniture with motors and code so that they move like characters.
creators.why: His telepresence furniture lets a person inhabit an everyday object, a rare XR case of becoming a thing rather than a creature.
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰艺术家、电影人，用电机和程序改装拾得物与废旧家具，让它们像角色一样动起来。
creators.why_zh: 他的远程临场家具让人住进一件日常物品里，是 XR 中少见的“成为物”而非成为生物的案例。

creators.name: Charl Linssen
creators.role: Computational neuroscientist and maker of responsive objects
creators.bio: Researcher in computer simulation of neural dynamics who also builds electronic and robotic objects that respond to their surroundings as if animated.
creators.why: Brings the neuroscience of body ownership and sensorimotor feedback to the telepresence chair he co-created with Werner van der Zwan.
creators.role_zh: 计算神经科学研究者、响应式物件创作者
creators.bio_zh: 从事神经动力学计算模拟的研究者，业余制作能对环境作出反应、仿佛有生命的电子与机器人物件。
creators.why_zh: 他把身体所有感与感觉运动反馈的神经科学带进了与 Werner van der Zwan 合作的远程临场椅子。

creators.name: Yangyang Yang
creators.role: HCI researcher, UC Berkeley School of Information
creators.bio: PhD researcher at the UC Berkeley School of Information who designs mobile and mixed-reality experiences that invite people to take more-than-human perspectives.
creators.why: Being The Creek asks participants to lie beside a creek and speak as the creek, an XR study of becoming a watercourse.
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者，加州大学伯克利分校信息学院
creators.bio_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校信息学院博士研究者，设计移动与混合现实体验，邀请人们采取超越人类的视角。
creators.why_zh: 《Being The Creek》让参与者躺在溪边、以溪流的口吻说话，是关于“成为一条水道”的 XR 研究。

creators.name: Kimiko Ryokai
creators.role: Professor, UC Berkeley School of Information
creators.bio: Professor at the UC Berkeley School of Information and the Berkeley Center for New Media whose research designs tangible and mobile technologies for creativity, learning and noticing.
creators.why: Co-author of Being The Creek, which uses mobile AR to shift participants toward a creek's first-person perspective.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校信息学院教授
creators.bio_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校信息学院与新媒体中心教授，研究面向创造、学习与觉察的实体与移动技术。
creators.why_zh: 《Being The Creek》的合作者，该作品用移动 AR 把参与者引向溪流的第一人称视角。

creators.name: Carolina Ramirez-Figueroa
creators.role: Senior Tutor, Information Experience Design, Royal College of Art
creators.bio: Designer and researcher at the Royal College of Art working across biodesign, archives and immersive media, with a focus on microbial life and time.
creators.why: Her VR work lets visitors become a dust-borne microbe and read a building's history at microbial scale.
creators.role_zh: 英国皇家艺术学院信息体验设计专业高级导师
creators.bio_zh: 英国皇家艺术学院的设计师与研究者，工作横跨生物设计、档案与沉浸媒体，关注微生物生命与时间。
creators.why_zh: 她的 VR 作品让观众成为尘埃中的一个微生物，以微生物的尺度阅读一栋建筑的历史。

creators.name: The Constitute
creators.bio: German collective of designers and artists (including Sebastian Piatza and Christian Zöllner) making speculative wearables, installations and education projects such as Fabmobil.
creators.why: Their Eyesect helmet moved the wearer's eyes onto their hands, an early HMD experiment in non-human vision.
creators.bio_zh: 德国设计师与艺术家团体（成员包括 Sebastian Piatza 与 Christian Zöllner），创作思辨性可穿戴装置、装置作品，并开展 Fabmobil 等教育项目。
creators.why_zh: 他们的 Eyesect 头盔把佩戴者的眼睛移到双手上，是早期用头显探索非人类视觉的实验。
creators.based_zh: 德累斯顿 / 柏林，德国

works.title: Unconventional Self
works.description: A telepresence installation in which a visitor wearing a VR headset sees through, and moves as, a motorised folding chair. A spoken choreographic text guides them as they learn what this stiff new body can and cannot do among other animated furniture.
works.description_zh: 一件远程临场装置：观众戴上 VR 头显，透过一把装了电机的折叠椅去看，并以它的身体移动。一段口述的编舞文本引导他们在其他会动的家具之间，摸索这具僵硬的新身体能做什么、不能做什么。
works.idea_en: Becoming a chair means learning a body through its resistance: the object's awkward, limited movements become your own possibilities and vulnerabilities.
works.idea_zh: 成为一把椅子，就是通过阻力去认识一具身体：物件笨拙而有限的动作，变成了你自己的可能与脆弱。
works.method: A camera on the found-furniture robot streams to a 3DOF VR headset; the participant's head and control inputs drive windshield-wiper motors in the chair's legs.
works.method_zh: 装在拾得家具机器人上的摄像头把画面传到三自由度 VR 头显；参与者的头部动作与操控输入驱动椅腿里的雨刮电机。
keywords: V2_ Lab for the Unstable Media
shown_at: Meta.Morf 2024, Trøndelag Centre for Contemporary Art, Trondheim

works.title: Being The Creek
works.description: Participants walk along Strawberry Creek in Berkeley and, at five stops, lie flat beside the water to unlock AR scenes of what the creek has lived through, from Indigenous care and use as an industrial sewer to a speculative future. They narrate what they see in the first person, as the creek.
works.description_zh: 参与者沿伯克利的 Strawberry Creek 行走，在五个地点平躺在水边，解锁 AR 场景，看见这条溪流经历过的历史：从原住民的敬重、工业时期被当作下水道，到一个思辨性的未来。他们以溪流的第一人称讲述眼前所见。
works.idea_en: Becoming a creek is a change of posture and pronoun: lying at water level and saying 'I' for the creek turns a backdrop into a subject with a history.
works.idea_zh: 成为溪流，是姿势与人称的改变：贴着水面躺下、以溪流的口吻说“我”，让一处背景变成一个有历史的主体。
works.method: A location-based mobile AR app on a tablet overlays historical and speculative scenes that only unlock when the participant lies down at each site beside the creek.
works.method_zh: 平板上的定位式移动 AR 应用叠加历史与思辨场景，只有参与者在溪边各站点躺下时才会解锁。

paper.title: Being The Creek: Mobile Augmented Reality Experience as an Invitation for Exploring More-Than-Human Perspectives

works.title: The Materialised Temporality of Dust
works.description: A VR experience in which the visitor becomes a microbe living in the dust of the Royal College of Art's Kensington library. They wake inside an out-of-scale bookshelf and pass through decades of the room's history before returning to the library as it is today.
works.description_zh: 一件 VR 作品：观众成为英国皇家艺术学院肯辛顿图书馆尘埃中的一个微生物。他们在比例失调的书架里醒来，穿过这个房间几十年的历史，最后回到今天的图书馆。
works.idea_en: History read at microbial scale: dust is an archive, and becoming one of its microbes swaps the human timeline for dormancy, sporulation and slow accumulation.
works.idea_zh: 以微生物的尺度阅读历史：尘埃是一座档案馆，成为其中的一个微生物，就是用休眠、孢子形成与缓慢堆积替换人类的时间线。
works.method: Microbes sampled from library dust, archival photographs and 3D scans of the space are combined into a VR journey following Bacillus subtilis.
works.method_zh: 把图书馆尘埃中采集的微生物、档案照片与空间 3D 扫描结合成一段跟随枯草芽孢杆菌（Bacillus subtilis）的 VR 旅程。

paper.title: The materialised temporality of dust: developing a biodesign methodology to spatialise time and temporalise space

works.title: Eyesect
works.description: A mirrored helmet whose two eye screens are fed by two handheld cameras, so each of the wearer's eyes looks wherever one hand points. Wearers explore space through split, independently moving eyes that no human body has.
works.description_zh: 一顶镜面头盔，两块眼前屏幕由两台手持摄像头供给画面，佩戴者的每只眼睛都看向一只手所指的方向。佩戴者用分开、各自移动的双眼探索空间，这是人类身体本不具备的视觉。
works.idea_en: Arms and fingers become eye muscles: moving the eyes off the head gives a first-person taste of a non-human visual body, like an animal whose eyes move independently.
works.idea_zh: 手臂和手指变成眼部肌肉：把眼睛从头上移开，让人以第一人称尝到一种非人类的视觉身体，如同双眼各自转动的动物。
works.method: Two handheld cameras stream separately to the left and right displays of a head-mounted display built into a resin helmet (an Oculus Rift in later versions), with the processing hardware inside the helmet.
works.method_zh: 两台手持摄像头分别把画面传到树脂头盔内头戴显示器的左右屏幕（后期版本使用 Oculus Rift），运算硬件都装在头盔里。

leads.name: Sitting with the Other (Werner van der Zwan & Charl Linssen)
leads.why: Named in the Augmented Noticing interview list as their chair VR work; no public source under this title. It is most likely the same project as Unconventional Self, or a paper about it.

leads.name: Lisa Thomas, climate-futures VR environment
leads.why: Listed as a possible interviewee in Augmented Noticing; not researched. It looks like a climate-futures VR scene rather than a becoming.

leads.name: Daniel Steegmann Mangrané, Phantom (Kingdom of all the animals and all the beasts is my name)
leads.why: VR walk through a scanned Atlantic rainforest (2015). You stay a ghostly human observer, so it reads as a counterpoint rather than a becoming.
